profile.headline: Web Developer  at SevenPoint2
profile.summary: I am a passionate, self-motivated, Web Developer/Designer who is constantly learning new skills.  I am currently working for SevenPoint2 where I use my excellent analytical abilities and technical skills to develop/maintain new and existing pages on the company's website -  sevenpoint2.com. I love interfacing with our users in Australia, Philippines and the United States. As a contractor, I am currently developing a website for D.H.K. Properties using WordPress MySQL, PHP.  I am currently designing/developing a website for students of all ages to improve their mastery of phonics through stories, comprehension tests and games using HTML5, CSS3, SASS, LESS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Bootstrap, PHP, MySQL, AWS.

positions.title: Web Developer/Technical Support
positions.description:
Working for an exciting startup leading the world in alkaline dieting, I perform the following in a fast-paced, agile, and responsive environment:
•	Use my excellent analytical abilities and technical skills to develop and maintain new/existing webpages using HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, PHP, and MySQL 
•	Use Git for our version control on all projects.
•	Am currently working on a new product (SKU) number generating system using PHP/MySQL, 
•	Create several ad hoc reports using PHP/MySQL on a weekly basis 
•	Responsible for debugging, troubleshooting and running test scenarios for technical issues with software applications, hardware  devices  
•	Implemented/support the new Fonality phone system company wide  
•	Create/design all new product pictures and banners for the company using Gimp
•	Responsible for developing, designing and posting content on the shopping for the website 
•	Provide exceptional customer service by understanding their needs and expectations  
•	Understand HTTP and server side errors

positions.title: Web Developer (Contractor - Part Time)
positions.description:
Company that creates Construction maps for the new housing communities in the competitive Southern California Housing market:
•	Developed and designed new company website using WordPress, MySQL, PHP 
•	Optimized data retrieval by 100% in the Map Division by converting data to a MySQL database

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Successfully completed an intensive 12 week, full immersion, project-oriented boot camp -- which is the equivalent of 12 months and 750 hours of training. Instructional curriculum included: 
•	Instructional format focused on coding around specific technologies and frameworks/libraries, including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/jQuery, AJAX, and Bootstrap on the client side, along with PHP/MySQL, Amazon AWS, and basic Apache on the server side.
•	Extensively utilized Github for version control in an agile development environment. 
•	Built, modified, and maintained numerous scalable applications/websites from inception to completion.

positions.title: Report Writer/Analyst
positions.description:
For this leading provider of compliance software and services for the banking, credit union and mortgage lending industries, I performed the following:
•	Restructured the style/format of Quest soft’s Market Data reports, increasing readability by 80% 
•	Designed and developed 80 new complex reports using report generator List & Label 
•	Optimized data retrieval by creating complex SQL queries to extract data from the MySQL database 
•	Created thorough specifications and test plans; participated in QA process; and tracked project deliverables

positions.title: Computer Teacher/Media Specialist / Substitute Teacher
positions.description:
•	 Maintained computer lab of 120 Dell PC computers with 100% usability at all times  
•	 Taught 600 elementary students per week – keyboard typing, Microsoft Office Suite and STMath
•	 Supported 30 teachers with technical questions and fixed computer-related issues 
•	 Created curriculum for PowerPoint projects to include Teacher’s lesson plans

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Part of a team that converted the COBOL IMS DC/DB Tracking System to a new PowerBuilder
  Application.
•	Designed and coded new programs in PowerBuilder with embedded SQL that accessed Oracle   
  tables for the new Tracking System     
•	Responsible for all unit and system testing and created user documentation 
•	Designed and presented training classes to the users for the new systems
